def bfp_sk2_compress(w):
    """Lossless 12-bit packing of BF16 W [N, K] into B-fragment tile-units [N/8, K/64, 768] (512 B low bytes, lane-major,
    then 256 B of 4-bit codes) + escapes (row, k, delta) that the kernel corrects exactly.  Returns None if unsuitable."""
    n, k = w.shape
    tu = bfp_sk2_tileunits(w)
    bits = tu.contiguous().view(torch.int16).to(torch.int32) & 0xFFFF
    hi = bits >> 8
    low = bits & 0xFF
    e71 = hi & 0x7F
    sign = hi >> 7
    hist = torch.bincount(e71.flatten(), minlength=128)
    win = torch.stack([hist[b:b + 8].sum() for b in range(121)])
    base = int(win.argmax())
    o = (e71 - base).clamp(0, 7)
    code = (sign << 3) | o
    esc = (e71 < base) | (e71 > base + 7)
    if int(esc.sum()) > n * k // 200:
        return None
    T, U = n // 8, k // 64
    c8 = code.to(torch.uint8)
    w0 = c8[..., 0:4] | (c8[..., 4:8] << 4)
    w1 = c8[..., 8:12] | (c8[..., 12:16] << 4)
    codes = torch.cat([w0, w1], dim=-1)                  # [T, U, 32, 8]
    packed = torch.cat([low.to(torch.uint8).reshape(T, U, 512), codes.reshape(T, U, 256)], dim=-1).contiguous()
    idx = esc.nonzero()                                   # [E, 4]: tile, unit, lane, v
    dec_bits = ((((sign << 7) | (base + o)) << 8) | low)[esc]
    wdec = dec_bits.to(torch.int16).view(torch.bfloat16).float()
    wtrue = tu[esc].float()
    delta = wtrue - wdec
    if not bool(((wdec + delta) == wtrue).all()):
        return None
    lane, v = idx[:, 2], idx[:, 3]
    rows = idx[:, 0] * 8 + (lane >> 2)
    cols = idx[:, 1] * 64 + 16 * (v >> 2) + 8 * ((v >> 1) & 1) + 2 * (lane & 3) + (v & 1)
    return {"packed": packed, "base4": base * 0x01010101, "rows": rows, "cols": cols, "delta": delta.contiguous()}

def bfp_sk2_compress(w):
    """V29: parent 12-bit primary plus exact single-bit-pattern repair or raw unit.

    Descriptor: top two bits 00=none, 01=single(position9,bits16), 10=raw index30.
    No distribution assumption: every overflow unit retains all 1024 original bytes.
    Entire matrices whose requested bytes exceed raw BF16 use existing other backends.
    """
    n, k = w.shape
    tu = bfp_sk2_tileunits(w)
    bits = tu.contiguous().view(torch.int16).to(torch.int32) & 0xFFFF
    hi, low = bits >> 8, bits & 0xFF
    e71, sign = hi & 0x7F, hi >> 7
    hist = torch.bincount(e71.flatten(), minlength=128)
    win = torch.stack([hist[b:b + 8].sum() for b in range(121)])
    base = int(win.argmax())
    off = (e71 - base).clamp(0, 7)
    code = (sign << 3) | off
    esc = ((e71 < base) | (e71 > base + 7)).reshape(n // 8, k // 64, 512)
    counts = esc.sum(-1)
    raw_mask, single = counts >= 2, counts == 1
    raw_count, single_count = int(raw_mask.sum()), int(single.sum())
    units = (n // 8) * (k // 64)
    if units * 772 + raw_count * 1024 >= units * 1024:
        return None
    T, U = n // 8, k // 64
    c8 = code.to(torch.uint8)
    codes = torch.cat([c8[..., 0:4] | (c8[..., 4:8] << 4),
                       c8[..., 8:12] | (c8[..., 12:16] << 4)], dim=-1)
    packed = torch.cat([low.to(torch.uint8).reshape(T, U, 512),
                        codes.reshape(T, U, 256)], dim=-1).contiguous()
    position = esc.to(torch.int32).argmax(-1)
    original = bits.reshape(T, U, 512).gather(-1, position.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
    desc = torch.zeros((T, U), dtype=torch.int64, device=w.device)
    desc[single] = (1 << 30) | (position[single].long() << 16) | original[single].long()
    raw_index = torch.arange(raw_count, dtype=torch.int64, device=w.device)
    desc[raw_mask] = (2 << 30) | raw_index
    raw = bits.reshape(T, U, 512)[raw_mask].to(torch.int16).contiguous().view(torch.uint8).reshape(raw_count, 1024)
    if raw_count == 0:
        raw = torch.zeros((1, 1024), dtype=torch.uint8, device=w.device)
    return {"packed": packed, "base4": base * 0x01010101,
            "descriptors": desc.to(torch.int32).contiguous(), "raw": raw,
            "stats": (units, single_count, raw_count, units * 772 + raw_count * 1024)}

def bfp_sk2_table(comp, n_cfg, R):
    """Per-CTA escape table int2 [ncta][pmax]: entry 0 = (count, 0); entries ((row_local << 16) | k, delta bits)."""
    dev = comp["rows"].device
    rows, cols, delta = comp["rows"], comp["cols"], comp["delta"]
    keep = rows < n_cfg
    rows, cols, delta = rows[keep], cols[keep], delta[keep]
    ncta = n_cfg // R
    cta = rows // R
    counts = torch.bincount(cta, minlength=ncta)
    pmax = int(counts.max().item()) + 1 if rows.numel() else 1
    pmax += pmax % 2
    order = torch.argsort(cta.long() * 65536 + cols.long())   # per CTA in k order (the kernel walks K once)
    cta, rows, cols, delta = cta[order], rows[order], cols[order], delta[order]
    start = torch.zeros(ncta + 1, dtype=torch.long, device=dev)
    start[1:] = torch.cumsum(counts, 0)
    slot = torch.arange(cta.numel(), device=dev) - start[cta] + 1
    tab = torch.zeros(ncta, pmax, 2, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
    tab[:, 0, 0] = counts.to(torch.int32)
    tab[cta, slot, 0] = (((rows % R) << 16) | cols).to(torch.int32)
    tab[cta, slot, 1] = delta.view(torch.int32)
    return tab.contiguous(), pmax

def bfp_sk2_patch_stream_v29(comp, n_cfg, R, NT, NWR, WSK, UPW):
    """Append aligned descriptor tail to each complete stage/CTA primary payload."""
    primary = bfp_sk2_stream(comp["packed"], n_cfg, R, NT, NWR, WSK, UPW)
    desc = bfp_sk2_stream(comp["descriptors"].unsqueeze(-1), n_cfg, R, NT, NWR, WSK, UPW)
    s, c = primary.shape[:2]
    tail = desc.contiguous().view(torch.uint8).reshape(s, c, -1)
    assert tail.shape[-1] % 16 == 0
    return torch.cat([primary.reshape(s, c, -1), tail], dim=-1).contiguous()
